During the event, register for this event to receive 2 USDT. Limited to the first 2,000 eligible users on a first-come, first-served basis.
## Event 2: First Transfer Gift, Claim Another 2 USDT
During the event, users who make their first transfer of at least $100 to their stock account will receive 2 USDT automatically. Limited to the first 5,000 eligible users on a first-come, first-served basis.
## Event 3: First Trade Milestone, Get an Extra 5 USDT
During the event, users who complete their first single stock trade with a trading volume of at least $500 will receive 5 USDT automatically. Limited to the first 5,000 eligible users on a first-come, first-served basis.
## Event 4: Advanced Trading Rewards, Earn 5 USDT
During the event, users who reach a cumulative stock trading volume of $2,000 will receive 5 USDT automatically. Limited to the first 400 eligible users on a first-come, first-served basis.
## All Stock Rewards in One Place
Stock campaigns keep rolling — referral, first trade, trading, holdings and leaderboard events, each with its own rewards

- Participants must click the [Join Now] button on the event page to register and complete Identity Verification to receive rewards.

- USDT rewards from Events 1, 2, and 3 will be automatically credited as Stock Trading Fee Rebate Vouchers with a 20% rebate rate. USDT rewards from Event 4 will be automatically credited as Stock Bonus. The corresponding event will automatically end once all rewards have been distributed.
- Due to local regulatory requirements, eligibility for this event will be dynamically adjusted based on actual circumstances. Users from certain countries or regions may not be able to register or participate in this event in the future. Please refer to the actual registration result for confirmation. Users who have successfully registered will not be affected.
- Gate will review account activity, transactions, and fund transfers during the event. Violations include participating repeatedly through multiple accounts, identity impersonation or submission of false verification information, wash trading or matched trading, circular transfers of on-chain funds, coordinated reward abuse, repeated fund transfers, and any other activities that compromise the fairness of the event. Gate reserves the right to disqualify users found to have engaged in such violations from receiving rewards.
- Market makers, enterprises, and institutions cannot participate in this event.
- If there are any discrepancies between the translated version and the English version, the English version shall prevail.

Headline: CFD Rewards Discovery: Invite Friends to Trade and Win a Prize on Every Draw

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
During the event, invite friends to register and complete the designated CFD trading task to earn draws, with a prize guaranteed on every draw. As your friends increase their trading volume, you can unlock tiered rewards of up to another $150 in XAUT.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 27, 2026, 08:00 - December 6, 2026, 08:00 (UTC)
How to participate: Complete the designated referral tasks to earn draws.
Event rewards: Draw prizes include CFD Position Vouchers, CFD Trading Fee Rebate Vouchers, and XAUT spot tokens. Rewards are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis. The prize pool is refreshed daily at 00:00 (UTC). If the pool is exhausted on the final day, the event will end automatically.
Reminder: Avoid frequent actions within a short period, as they may trigger risk controls and affect your draw results or ability to claim rewards.
## Event 1: Invite Friends to Trade and Win a Prize on Every Draw
During the event, invite a friend to register and reach at least $2,000 in CFD trading volume. This counts as one valid referral and gives you one draw, with a prize guaranteed. Each inviter can earn draws from up to five friends. The more qualifying friends you invite, the more draws you earn.
## Event 2: Friends Trade More, Inviters Earn Up to $150 in XAUT
During the event, inviters can claim the corresponding reward when their invited friends reach the CFD trading volume tiers below. Each friend is counted only at their highest qualifying tier; rewards across tiers cannot be combined, but rewards from different friends can be combined.
Each inviter can earn rewards from up to five qualifying friends, with a maximum of $150 worth of XAUT spot tokens. The total prize pool is $15,000 worth of XAUT.
- Tier 1: Trading volume ≥ $20,000 — $1 in XAUT
- Tier 2: Trading volume ≥ $100,000 — $3 in XAUT
- Tier 3: Trading volume ≥ $1,000,000 — $5 in XAUT
- Tier 4: Trading volume ≥ $5,000,000 — $10 in XAUT
- Tier 5: Trading volume ≥ $20,000,000 — $30 in XAUT
## Notes
- Participants must click Join Now on the event page to register and complete identity verification to receive rewards. Some regions may not support registration or participation. Please refer to the event page for availability.
- Trading volume = buy volume + sell volume.
- Event 1 rewards are distributed instantly on a first-come, first-served basis. The CFD Trading Fee Rebate Voucher has a rebate rate of 20%. Event 2 rewards will be credited to users’ accounts within 14 business days after the event ends.
- Friends must register using the inviter’s exclusive referral code to qualify.
- Gate TradFi services may be restricted in certain jurisdictions and unavailable to users in some regions. Trading traditional financial instruments involves market price fluctuations, leverage risk, and liquidity risk. Please read the CFD Service Agreement, Risk Disclosure Statement, and applicable asset terms carefully before trading on TradFi.
- Gate will review account activity, trades, and fund movements during the event. Violations include using multiple accounts to participate repeatedly, impersonation or submitting false verification information, self-trading or matched trading, recycling on-chain funds, organizing schemes to obtain rewards, repeated fund transfers, and other conduct affecting event fairness. Upon verification, Gate reserves the right to disqualify the users involved from receiving rewards.
- Market makers, enterprises, institutions, broker accounts, and users referred by brokers are not eligible to participate.
- Users participating in multiple referral events held during the same period may receive rewards from only one event.
- If there is any discrepancy between translated versions and the English version, the English version will prevail.
- Gate reserves the right of final interpretation of this event due to changes in market conditions, fraud risks, and other factors.
- Users in the United Kingdom and other restricted regions may not be able to access all or part of the services, including this event, games, or competitions. Please refer to the User Agreement for details. We do not intend to solicit or market to customers in such restricted regions.
- Important Notice: Crypto markets are highly volatile. Users are strongly advised to seek independent professional advice, fully understand all relevant information, and exercise caution when taking any action.

Headline: Kinetiq (KNTQ) Listing Campaign — 328,400 KNTQ Giveaway

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
To celebrate Kinetiq (KNTQ) being listed on KuCoin, we will be launching a campaign to give away a 328,400 KNTQ prize pool to qualified KuCoin users!
Trading Opening Time: 09:00 on November 27, 2026 (UTC)
Learn more about Kinetiq (KNTQ) here.
## Activity 1: Trade to Share a 276,900 KNTQ Prize Pool with KNTQ GemSlot Carnival
Campaign Period: From 09:00 on November 27, 2026, to 09:00 on December 4, 2026 (UTC)
Click "Join Now" to participate!
Once users successfully enroll in the campaign, they will automatically participate in the following two reward pools:
## (Pool 1) Lucky Draw — Trade KNTQ to Share 55,380 KNTQ!
All KuCoin users who complete at least $250 spot trading volume of KNTQ during the campaign period will qualify for the Lucky Draw.
New users will receive 2× rewards.
Users who successfully invite at least 3 new users to register and complete KYC will also receive 2× rewards.
## (Pool 2) Trading Carnival — Trade KNTQ, XRP and KCS to Share 221,520 KNTQ!
Users must achieve a minimum spot trading volume of $600 in KNTQ/USDT during the campaign period to qualify for rewards. Once eligible, users may continue trading KNTQ/USDT, XRP/USDT and KCS/USDT to increase their share of the 221,520 KNTQ prize pool.
KNTQ trading volume will be counted as 2× toward the reward calculation.
Rewards will be allocated based on each user’s proportion of the total trading volume. The higher the adjusted trading volume, the greater the potential reward share, subject to a maximum cap of 3,250 KNTQ per user.
KCS loyalty tiers and GemSlot loyal users can enjoy additional trading volume boosts!
## Activity 2: Learn & Earn — Learn About Kinetiq (KNTQ) and Share 51,500 KNTQ
Campaign Period: From 08:00 on December 1, 2026, to 08:00 on December 15, 2026 (UTC)
Learning page coming soon.
During the campaign, users who complete the learning content, quiz, and designated tasks related to Kinetiq (KNTQ) will be eligible to share KNTQ rewards on a first-come, first-served basis.
Activity 1 Notes
For the Lucky Draw Pool, rewards will be distributed to eligible users in accordance with the campaign rules and qualification requirements.
For the Lucky Draw Pool, a qualifying “new user” refers to a user who registers a new KuCoin account during the campaign period and completes full KYC verification. Users who successfully invite at least 3 qualifying new users will be eligible for the corresponding invitation bonus. The invitation bonus and the new user reward multiplier are cumulative and may be applied simultaneously if the eligibility criteria for both are satisfied.
Market maker accounts and institutional accounts are not eligible to participate in this campaign.
For the Trading Carnival Pool, the total trading volume will be calculated as follows:
• Total Trading Volume Calculation: ((KNTQ-USDT Trading Volume × 2) + Trading Volume of XRP-USDT and KCS-USDT) × Boost Multiplier
• Reward Calculation: (Your Total Trading Volume ÷ Total Trading Volume of All Users) × 221,520 KNTQ.
Terms and Conditions
Trading Volume = (buys + sells) x price.
Complete KYC verification to participate in the event. Accounts associated with the same identity will be considered a single participant. Sub-accounts are not eligible.
The trading activity on the platform will undergo rigorous inspection during the activity. For any malicious acts conducted during the period, including malicious transaction manipulations, illegal bulk registration of accounts, self-dealing, etc., the platform will cancel the qualification of the participants. KuCoin reserves all rights to exercise at its sole discretion to define if the transaction behavior is counted as cheating behavior and determine whether to cancel the participation qualification of a user. The final decision made by KuCoin is legal binding force on all participants who participated in the competition. Users hereby confirm that their registration and use of KuCoin are voluntary and are not forced, interfered with, or influenced by KuCoin in any way.
KuCoin reserves the right to disqualify users' reward eligibility if the account is involved in any dishonest behavior (e.g., wash trading, illegally bulk registered accounts, self-dealing, or market manipulation).
KuCoin reserves the final right to interpret these terms and conditions, including but not limited to the modification, change, or cancellation of the activity, without further notice.
Any disputes or inquiries regarding campaign results must be submitted within two (2) months following the end of the campaign. KuCoin reserves the right to decline requests for review submitted after this period, except where otherwise required by applicable law.
Where any discrepancy arises between the translated and original English versions, the English version shall prevail.
Investments in digital assets can be risky. Please carefully evaluate the risks of a product and your risk tolerance based on your own financial circumstances.
Apple is not a sponsor and is not involved in the activity in any manner.
